entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rodolfo Gustavo da Paixão was a Brazilian marshal and politician, who served as the Governor of the state of Goiás twice, February 1890 to January 1891, and again July to December 1891. He was decorated with the Knight of the Military Order of Avis and Gold Military Medal.
